critical_code_review_comments: admin_router.py /api/admin/cancel-subscription doesn't filter is_super_admin from update — if user_id of a super admin were ever passed by mistake it could mark the platform owner's subscription cancelled. Other endpoints (reset-password, toggle-active, extend-trial, set-plan) correctly use {is_super_admin: {$ne: true}} guard; cancel-subscription should match for consistency.

admin_router.py /api/admin/feature-flags PUT accepts Dict[str,bool] with NO validation against DEFAULT_FLAGS keys — caller can inject arbitrary keys into feature_flags collection which then pollute subsequent GETs. Recommend whitelisting against DEFAULT_FLAGS keys.

server.py MaintenanceMiddleware: prefix-match on ALWAYS_OPEN_PATHS uses startswith, which means a tenant route accidentally prefixed '/api/admin-anything' would bypass maintenance. Today all admin routes are under /api/admin/ so it's safe, but consider using an explicit trailing slash compare or set lookup.

server.py MaintenanceMiddleware: settings are fetched from MongoDB on EVERY non-bypassed request — high traffic will cause one extra DB roundtrip per request. Consider in-process TTL cache (10-30s) since settings change rarely.
AdminDashboard.jsx: DialogContent for 'View as user' and other modals missing aria-describedby — Radix UI emits warning. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby={undefined} suppression.

AdminDashboard.jsx: 'Lifetime Revenue' (₹4,497) is computed from subscription_orders.amount sum which mixes monthly/quarterly/yearly amounts — labeling it 'Lifetime Revenue' is accurate but the MRR Estimate next to it (₹4,497) is misleading because backend computes MRR from active subscribers × plan_monthly map — verify the two cards aren't confusingly identical when they happen to coincide.

Backup endpoint dumps up to 50000 docs PER collection synchronously into one JSON response — this will OOM and stall the worker on a real-size tenant set. Should stream as NDJSON or chunk per collection.
